name: 600 STATES Observation Verification Protocol
principle: If it cannot be verified, it cannot become a tile.

rules.rule: A GDELT row or cluster is discovery evidence only and is never sufficient by itself for final tile admission.
Each admitted News Observation must have at least one accessible high-quality journalistic or primary official source that directly supports the neutral observation.
Contested, partisan, wartime, casualty, accusation or intelligence claims must be explicitly attributed unless independently established by stronger evidence.
Where the underlying claim cannot be independently verified, the observation may describe the verified fact that the claim was made, but not convert the claim into fact.
The observation must belong to the information state observable on the target UTC day. Publication, update and event timestamps must not be conflated.
Multiple articles reporting the same material fact state collapse into one News Observation.
A single Event Cluster may yield multiple News Observations only when each represents a materially distinct development or knowledge state.
No candidate may be admitted to fill a quota, improve geographic balance, alter emotion mix or improve the artwork if verification is insufficient.
The final 600-observation selection is frozen before emotion classification or color generation.
Rejected candidates and rejection reasons are retained in the audit trail.
